name: @tpmjs/tools-github
description: GitHub API tools for AI agents. Manage repos, issues, pull requests, commits, branches, releases, and gists.

tools.name: getRepo
tools.description: Get details of a GitHub repository including stars, forks, and language.

tools.name: listRepos
tools.description: List repositories for a user or organization with optional filtering.

tools.name: createIssue
tools.description: Create a new issue on a GitHub repository.

tools.name: getIssue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue by number.

tools.name: listIssues
tools.description: List issues on a repository with state and label filters.

tools.name: createIssueComment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing GitHub issue or pull request.

tools.name: getPullRequest
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request by number.

tools.name: listPullRequests
tools.description: List pull requests on a repository with state and head/base filters.

tools.name: getFileContent
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository.

tools.name: searchCode
tools.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories.

tools.name: searchRepositories
tools.description: Search GitHub repositories by query with sort and order options.

tools.name: listBranches
tools.description: List branches on a GitHub repository.

tools.name: getCommit
tools.description: Get details of a specific commit by SHA.

tools.name: listCommits
tools.description: List commits on a repository with optional path and author filters.

tools.name: listReleases
tools.description: List releases on a GitHub repository.

tools.name: getRelease
tools.description: Get details of a specific release by tag name.

tools.name: createGist
tools.description: Create a new GitHub Gist with one or more files.

tools.name: listGists
tools.description: List gists for the authenticated user or a specific user.

tools.name: listWorkflowRuns
tools.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository.

tools.name: getWorkflowRun
tools.description: Get details of a specific GitHub Actions workflow run.
